camel_example: aliyun rds ImportUserBackupFile --region cn-hangzhou --BackupFile 'Bucket_:_test_,_Object_:_test/test_db_employees.xb_,_Location_:_ap-southeast-1' --Comment BackupTest --EngineVersion '5.7' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --SourceInfo 'sourceIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_sourcePort_:_9999' --BuildReplication true --Mode oss --Retention 30 --MasterInfo 'masterIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_masterPort_:_3306_,_masterUser_:_replica_,_masterPassword_:_W33uopkehBQ=' --BucketRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RestoreSize 20
description_en: Imports backup data from a self-managed MySQL 5.7 database into ApsaraDB RDS by using the data import feature
description_zh: 该接口用于将自建库MySQL 5.7的备份数据导入至RDS
kebab_example: aliyun rds import-user-backup-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode oss --engine-version 5.7 --bucket-region cn-hangzhou --backup-file Bucket_:_test_,_Object_:_test/test_db_employees.xb_,_Location_:_ap-southeast-1 --comment BackupTest --restore-size 20 --retention 30 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --source-info sourceIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_sourcePort_:_9999 --build-replication true --master-info masterIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_masterPort_:_3306_,_masterUser_:_replica_,_masterPassword_:_W33uopkehBQ= --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportUserBackupFile

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the region ID.

The value of this parameter specifies the region ID in which you want to create the ApsaraDB RDS instance.
The value must be the same as the value of the BucketRegion parameter
parameters.help_zh:
RDS地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

本参数的值为您希望创建RDS实例的地域ID。
需要和BucketRegion参数的值保持一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The import mode. Valid values:

oss: imports the backup from OSS.
stream: imports the backup over the network
parameters.help_zh:
导入模式，取值说明：

oss：从OSS下载备份导入。
stream：通过网络导入备份
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The version of the MySQL database engine. Valid values: 5.7 and 8.0
parameters.help_zh: MySQL数据库的版本号。当前支持传入5.7或8.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the OSS bucket that stores the backup file of the self-managed MySQL 5.7 database. You can call DescribeRegions to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 自建MySQL 5.7备份文件所在OSS Bucket的地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: bucket_region

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array that describes the backup file information in the OSS bucket. Example:
`{"Bucket":"test", "Object":"test/test_db_employees.xb","Location":"ap-southeast-1"}`

The following list describes the parameters in the array:
Bucket: the name of the OSS bucket that stores the backup file. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31965.html to query the bucket name.
Object: the full path of the backup file in the directory. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31980.html to query the path.
Location: the region ID of the OSS bucket. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31967.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
描述OSS Bucket中备份文件信息的JSON数组。示例：
`{"Bucket":"test", "Object":"test/test_db_employees.xb","Location":"ap-southeast-1"}`

数组中各参数的说明如下：
Bucket：备份文件所在OSS Bucket的名称。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31965.html获取。
Object：备份文件所在目录的详细路径。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31980.html获取。
Location：OSS Bucket所在地域的ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31967.html获取
parameters.name: backup_file

parameters.help_en: The description of the user backup to be imported
parameters.help_zh: 要导入的用户备份的备注信息
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The storage space required to restore the user backup. Unit: GB.

The default value is five times the size of the backup file.
The minimum value is 20
parameters.help_zh:
还原用户备份所需存储空间大小。单位：GB。

默认为备份文件的5倍大小。
最小值为20
parameters.name: restore_size

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the user backup file. Unit: days. The value must be an integer greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 用户备份文件保留时长。单位：天。取值为大于0的Integer类型整数
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the zone ID.

After you specify a zone, the system creates a second-level snapshot in the zone, which significantly reduces the time required for backup import.
When you call CreateDBInstance to create an instance from the user backup, this zone is the zone in which the new instance resides
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions查询。

设置可用区后，系统会在该可用区内创建一个秒级快照，大幅节省备份导入所需要的时间。
调用CreateDBInstance使用用户备份创建新实例时，该可用区即为新实例所在的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array that provides the source information for the full backup (case-sensitive). Example:

```
{"sourceIp":"172.20.xx
.xx","sourcePort":"9999"}

```

The following list describes the parameters in the array:

`sourceIp`: the source IP address.

`sourcePort`: the Netcat listening port on the source.

This parameter takes effect only for native replication instances. You must specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
提供全量备份的源端信息的JSON数组（大小写敏感）。示例：

```
{"sourceIp":"172.20.xx
.xx","sourcePort":"9999"}

```

数组中各参数的说明如下：

`sourceIp`：源端IP。

`sourcePort`：源端Netcat监听的端口。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: source_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically set up replication. Valid values:
true: automatically sets up replication. The `MasterInfo` parameter is required.
false: does not set up replication.

This parameter takes effect only for native replication instances. You must specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动搭建复制，取值说明：
true：是，`MasterInfo`参数必填。
false：否。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: build_replication

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array that contains the master information for setting up MySQL replication (case-sensitive). Example:

```
{"masterIp":"172.20.xx.xx","masterPort":"3306","masterUser":"replica","masterPassword":"W33uopkehBQ="}

```

The following list describes the parameters in the array:
`masterIp`: the IP address of the primary database.
`masterPort`: the port of the primary database.
`masterUser`: the replication account of the primary database.
`masterPassword`: the password of the replication account for the primary database. The password must be Base64-encoded.

This parameter takes effect only for native replication instances. You must specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
搭建MySQL复制的Master信息的JSON数组（大小写敏感）。示例：

```
{"masterIp":"172.20.xx.xx","masterPort":"3306","masterUser":"replica","masterPassword":"W33uopkehBQ="}

```

数组中各参数的说明如下：
`masterIp`：主库IP。
`masterPort`：主库端口。
`masterUser`：主库复制账号。
`masterPassword`：主库复制账号密码，需要进行Base64加密。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: master_info

Status.description_en: Indicates whether the user backup is imported. The value true is returned if the import is successful. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Status.description_zh: 导入用户备份是否成功。是则返回true，否则返回错误信息
